title: Modi Served World Leaders a Meatless Meal, and His Critics Pounced
summary_full: Opposition politicians said a vegetarian dinner served at a diplomatic summit misrepresented India’s culinary heritage. A minister in Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s government rejected the criticism.
